description: This file contains utility functions for managing exam environments, including exam generation, validation, scoring, and constructing user-facing exam data within a TypeScript project. It interacts with Prisma ORM models and Fastify server framework components.

methods.name: checkPrerequisites
methods.description: Checks if all exam prerequisites are met by the user, including challenge completion and honesty policy acceptance.

methods.name: constructUserExam
methods.description: Creates a user-facing exam object from generated and original exam data, including shuffling answers and ordering question sets.

methods.name: validateAttempt
methods.description: Validates that all questions and answers in an attempt are from the generated exam.

methods.name: checkAttemptAgainstGeneratedExam
methods.description: Verifies that all question sets and questions in an attempt are present in the generated exam, and answers are valid.

methods.name: userAttemptToDatabaseAttemptQuestionSets
methods.description: Updates question set attempts with submission times if answers have changed.

methods.name: generateExam
methods.description: Generates a randomized exam based on the exam configuration, shuffling questions and answers, and fulfilling tag and question count constraints.

methods.name: calculateScore
methods.description: Calculates the percentage score of an exam attempt based on correct answers.

methods.name: compareAnswers
methods.description: Compares user answers with correct answers to determine correctness.

methods.name: isQuestionSetConfigFulfilled
methods.description: Checks if a question set configuration has been fulfilled with the required number of questions and sets.

methods.name: getRandomAnswers
methods.description: Selects a specified number of correct and incorrect answers randomly for a question.

methods.name: shuffleArray
methods.description: Shuffles an array using the Fisher-Yates algorithm.

methods.name: constructEnvExamAttempt
methods.description: Constructs the exam attempt object with result and status, handling different moderation and expiration states.
